sections.title: Visuals
sections.description: The look of the world: distance, clouds, fog, sky, wind and leaves.

options.label: Render distance
options.tooltip: How many chunks of real terrain are loaded around you. Voxy draws the far distance beyond this.

options.label: Graphics
options.tooltip: Fast, Fancy or Fabulous. Fabulous is not needed with shaders.

options.label: Better Clouds
options.tooltip: Volumetric clouds instead of vanilla's flat layer.

options.label: Cloud distance
options.tooltip: How far the cloud layer is drawn, as a multiple of your render distance.

options.label: Cloud gaps
options.tooltip: Higher values punch more holes into the cloud layer.

options.label: Cloud speed
options.tooltip: How fast clouds drift across the sky.

options.label: Better Fog
options.tooltip: Fog that follows time of day, weather, caves and biomes.

options.label: Fog haze
options.tooltip: Extra distant haze on top of the fog curve.

options.label: Fog noise
options.tooltip: Drifting density variation in the fog. 0 keeps it uniform.

options.label: Pixel-style auroras
options.tooltip: Auroras drawn in chunky pixels instead of smooth bands.

options.label: Aurora detail
options.tooltip: Segments per aurora band. Higher is smoother and costlier.

options.label: Better Night
options.tooltip: Darker nights that follow the moon phase and weather.

options.label: Night darkness
options.tooltip: How dark nights get. Custom means you tuned the individual values.

options.label: Texture filtering
options.tooltip: Sharpens distant and grazing-angle block textures. SHARP_8X is the sweet spot.

options.label: Wind streaks
options.tooltip: Wind Waker-style lines in the air when the wind blows.

options.label: Wind density
options.tooltip: How many streaks, drifting leaves and petals the wind carries.

options.label: Wind-blown leaves
options.tooltip: Leaves matching nearby trees drift through the air.

options.label: Falling leaves
options.tooltip: How many leaves fall from trees. 0 disables them.

options.label: Rain density
options.tooltip: Rain and snow particles per tick. Lower on weak GPUs.

options.label: Also draw vanilla rain
options.tooltip: Keep vanilla's rain sheets on top of the particle rain.

options.label: Shaders
options.tooltip: Turn the current shader pack on or off without leaving this screen.

options.label: Shader packs
options.tooltip: Pick a shader pack and tune its own options.

sections.title: Performance
sections.description: Frame rate levers. Start with distances, then far terrain.

options.label: Simulation distance
options.tooltip: How far mobs, crops and redstone keep ticking. Lower is cheaper on the CPU.

options.label: Frame rate limit
options.tooltip: Cap the frame rate to save power and heat.

options.label: VSync
options.tooltip: Lock frames to the monitor refresh. Off for lowest input lag.

options.label: Far terrain (Voxy)
options.tooltip: Draw low-detail terrain beyond the render distance.

options.label: Far terrain distance
options.tooltip: How far Voxy draws, in 32-block sections. Big values need VRAM.

options.label: Fog on far terrain
options.tooltip: Blend the far terrain into the fog instead of a hard edge.

options.label: Receive server LODs
options.tooltip: Let the server send far terrain it has already generated.

options.label: Server LOD radius
options.tooltip: Chunks of far terrain to request. 0 picks the smaller of the server cap and your Voxy distance.

options.label: Weather quality
options.tooltip: Rain and snow rendering detail.

options.label: Leaves quality
options.tooltip: Fancy leaves show through, fast leaves are solid.

options.label: Skip hidden entity ticks
options.tooltip: Entities you cannot see skip their client animations.

options.label: HUD batching
options.tooltip: Draw the HUD in fewer GPU calls.

options.label: FPS overlay
options.tooltip: Small frame counter in the corner.

sections.title: Immersion
sections.description: Camera feel, animations, water and the little touches.

options.label: Camera momentum
options.tooltip: Subtle camera banking and dips when you strafe, turn, land and sprint.

options.label: Momentum strength
options.tooltip: Overall amount of camera motion.

options.label: Elytra vapor trails
options.tooltip: Jet-style wingtip trails while gliding fast.

options.label: Speed lines
options.tooltip: First-person streaks that bloom the faster you move.

options.label: Zoom strength
options.tooltip: How far the zoom key zooms. Lower is closer.

options.label: Free third-person camera
options.tooltip: Turn the camera without turning your character.

options.label: Boat wake detail
options.tooltip: Resolution of the ripples boats and swimmers leave.

options.label: Dynamic lights
options.tooltip: Held torches and glowing mobs light the world around them.

options.label: 3D skin layer distance
options.tooltip: How far away players still get 3D hats and sleeves.

options.label: Item swap animation
options.tooltip: Animate switching the held item instead of popping it in.

options.label: Dynamic crosshair
options.tooltip: The crosshair changes shape for blocks, entities, tools and interactions.

options.label: Bed clock position
options.tooltip: Where the clock sits while you sleep.

options.label: Food values in tooltips
options.tooltip: Show hunger and saturation on food without holding Shift.

options.label: Saturation overlay
options.tooltip: Draw your saturation on top of the hunger bar.

options.label: Block info overlay
options.tooltip: Jade's popup naming the block or mob you look at.

options.label: Block info opacity
options.tooltip: Background opacity of the Jade overlay.

options.label: Item zoom preview
options.tooltip: A big render of the hovered item next to the inventory.

options.label: Item zoom scale
options.tooltip: Size of the zoomed item preview.

options.label: Show auto tool in hand
options.tooltip: Show the tool the rack picked in your first-person hand while it is in use.

options.label: Arms while carrying
options.tooltip: Render arms on the sides when carrying a block or mob.

options.label: Auto-jump
options.tooltip: Hop up single blocks automatically.

options.label: Toggle sprint
options.tooltip: Press once to sprint instead of holding.

sections.title: Social
sections.description: Voice, chat and what other players see.

options.label: Voice chat volume
options.tooltip: Volume of other players' voices.

options.label: Microphone mode
options.tooltip: Push-to-talk or voice activation.

options.label: Noise suppression
options.tooltip: Filter keyboard and fan noise out of your microphone.

options.label: Voice HUD icons
options.tooltip: Microphone and connection icons on the HUD.

options.label: Inline image previews
options.tooltip: Show image and GIF links in chat as previews. Fetching a link reveals your IP to that server.

options.label: Animated chat
options.tooltip: New messages slide in from below.

options.label: Chat visibility
options.tooltip: Shown, commands only, or hidden.

options.label: Allow server listing
options.tooltip: Let servers show your name in their public player list.
